user.title: Cloudflare Authentication
user.description: Enter your Cloudflare API Token. Ensure it has Zone:Zone:Read and Zone:DNS:Edit permissions.

zone_selection.title: Select Domain and Record
zone_selection.description: Select the domain (zone) and enter the record name you want to update.

data_description.enable_proxy: Enables Cloudflare's orange-cloud proxy. Required for SSL. Without this, the integration only manages your DNS record.

cert_confirmation.title: Certificate Already Exists
cert_confirmation.description: A certificate already exists at /ssl/fullchain.pem. Continuing will replace it.

data.confirm_overwrite: I understand, replace the existing certificate

error.auth_failed: Failed to authenticate. Check your token and permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Cloudflare API.
error.no_zones: No domains were found on this Cloudflare account.
error.proxy_entry_exists: A proxied entry already exists. Only one proxied record is allowed.
error.nonproxy_entry_exists: A non-proxied entry already exists. Only one non-proxied record is allowed.
